result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on whether you need straightforward employee management, payroll, holiday tracking, recruitment or a complete HR system.

**If you're a UK-based small business, I'd shortlist CharlieHR, Breathe HR, Employment Hero and BrightHR.** They're more relevant to UK employment requirements than US-focused platforms such as Gusto.

## My top HR software recommendations

![Charlie Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/noUj6MXVV_rGiJLKtx7Sco_uFMazap-Xj1f5ZnbuWxRGBtoatMU6LXITBFxA8JUNPcWFD9T5pr_JiMeu656E7ai9bkUmdzZ5rOMZPBS9cgUZr_b99qJ7RflQxghLNMkwNZfoMUQ-02gNA9PIKaI2sy72PQwjqiP-vw0XxBZrHM6gFjfEXb1dklqCyzGWic1V?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. CharlieHR**

(Best overall for small teams)

- Employee records and documentation
- Holiday and absence management
- Onboarding and performance reviews
- Straightforward interface

Particularly good for companies with 5–50 employees.

[CharlieHR website](https://www.charliehr.com/)

---

![HR Software for UK SMEs – Trusted by 17,000+ organisations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ROJAyOfUjHKEuFBNF1pHBPQHM0PLuIvCK0q8KQmZrpoEEyCHgmWjxWwAG_Ie8huEC0fFM24TmHCcpJtbR20JLvAHxGrWA4a6X3g_walj1XXFjcLPUM-k569UTN3Z62cwoEkeqnSg04nvlm5wphVNQ53Z9B30NqsDUYyfVczvoF43_i0QLqIID3NrWQR4SDCe?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Breathe HR**

(Best for simple HR administration)

- Holiday and sickness tracking
- Employee records
- Document storage
- Training and performance management

Good for businesses wanting to move away from spreadsheets.

[Breathe HR website](https://www.breathehr.com/)

---

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero**

- HR, payroll and employee management
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Employee self-service
- Workflow automation

Best if you want a broader system that can grow with your company.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightHR Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gC8IBBAPqsI2SVAsk3R4LrjZoZ-5bxi7-EcbEOB3KcHp8PDQa9qOw6ACIrb9VLYyhu5FvjAufdNhybguWPQ0Cv6UR_YRx4cxN2icpeqA44dqytZ2-60t-718dPbQhnh3gVgNGJqWtkwGZo6NQVxbB9SkuMVSsHOvLvkIBm5LE-4JdPACOxhQJgCF8aJsIlF8?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. BrightHR**

- Holiday and absence management
- HR documentation
- Employee rotas and time management
- HR advice and support options

Worth considering if you also want access to HR guidance.

[BrightHR website](https://www.brighthr.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bamboohr Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NdLSBGjy-t4LAE90fgF-ddR4i37sUJnkP2I2etLyMCzK30ZNnDLeOFNkJ4ONgornqI4dpQO60O7vJzcBWlKGYP0PmgOwkcxyOEu4BL3JtyYZ8ZsdTCrW5IgVGOXAbKINwLVIP8GRxZkWvj639AwhCvO-Z0MW5ibDEnj4uSEouHdZBnZYXe0Ke7Brv94puUyT?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. BambooHR**

- Employee database
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance management
- Reporting and analytics

A strong option for businesses with more developed HR requirements.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

## Which would I choose?

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-round small business HR | CharlieHR |
| Affordable, straightforward HR | Breathe HR |
| HR and payroll together | Employment Hero |
| HR advice and employment support | BrightHR |
| More advanced HR management | BambooHR |


UK pricing varies by employee numbers, package and add-ons, so I'd get quotes before committing. CharlieHR's published entry pricing starts at £21/month for 1–4 employees, while Breathe HR starts at £24/month for 1–10 employees. search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
